translation: The Jingming bone (睛明骨) is the orbital bone surrounding the four sides of the eye socket. Its upper part is called the brow ridge bone (眉稜骨), and its lower part is called the cheek bone (䪼骨); the cheek bone connects below to the upper dental arch. If injured by a fall or blow, with blood flowing over the whole face, apply Dao Chuang Yao (刀瘡藥); if there is swelling and pain with stagnant blood, apply Hunyuan Ointment (混元膏).
